summaries.en: SegFormer-WebSegCL25-2000-MC-v2 is a fine-tuned semantic segmentation model that excels at identifying 25 common web interface elements like buttons, forms, and navigation bars from screenshots. It builds on the efficient SegFormer architecture with a Mix Transformer encoder, achieving precise pixel-level classification while maintaining computational efficiency through hierarchical feature extraction. Developers can use it via Hugging Face's pipeline API to automatically annotate UI components, enabling applications in web accessibility testing, automated UI analysis, and training data generation for frontend development tools.
summaries.zh: SegFormer-WebSegCL25-2000-MC-v2 是一个专门针对网页界面语义分割的微调模型，能够精准识别按钮、表单、导航栏等25种常见网页元素。该模型基于SegFormer架构，采用混合Transformer编码器实现分层特征提取，在保持计算效率的同时完成像素级分类。开发者可通过Hugging Face接口直接调用，自动标注截图中的UI组件，适用于网页无障碍测试、界面自动化分析等场景，也可为前端开发工具生成训练数据，帮助构建更智能的网页设计辅助系统。
